title: Word Processing (MS Word)
author: 3iGR44tcGMnRnhEYm
chapter_outcomes: Edit page layout including page size, page orientation, page margins, number of columns, column width, spacing between columns, set and remove breaks (page, section and column breaks)
Set line spacing including: single, 1.5 times, double, multiple, spacing before and after paragraphs
Set tabulation including: left, right, centred and decimal tabs, indented paragraphs and hanging paragraphs
Text enhancement including bold, underline, italic, superscript and subscript, changes in case
Create or edit lists including bulleted, numbered
Find and replace text Including matching case, whole words
